notes.title: Hotfix 0.2b
notes.notes:
[h1]Changes[/h1]

A few general changes and maintenance, including fixes for two game-breaking bugs.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Michaela can no longer launch herself out of the arena
[*] The Brassbarian now [i]actually[/i] deals damage when he spins
[*] Tooltips no longer display if the item you're hovering isn’t visible/underground
[*] Dashing is no longer triggered if another directional input happens between the double tap
[*] Fixed Michaela's lightning strike being too high off the ground
[*] Adjusted the position of the end-of-wave portal
[*] Death camera now properly follows the player
[/list]

[h2]Visual[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Gatling Gary's splash text being out of focus
[*] Made lightning strike indicators more visible
[*] The Yamaguchi Super Glue now has a visual effect
[*] Improvements to the portal and UI in the death menu
[*] Gurdy’s Belt now has tassels again
[*] Updated the Brassbarian's slide particle
[/list]

[h2]Audio[/h2]
[list]
[*] Farts are now audible
[*] The bassoon has a placeholder reload success sound
[*] Throwing maracas makes a sound
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.2a Error fixed!
notes.notes:
[h1]The game works again![/h1]

Some minor changes that have been made since yesterday:

[b]General changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the .exe directory issue
[*] The game now displays the correct patch version on the top right of the screen
[*] The Sausage Roll now has an extended description
[*] Gurdy now whistles when unarmed
[*] Michaela uses her guitar(s)
[*] Reworked Sausage Roll "jump" sounds
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update v0.2: The Brassbarian Returns!
notes.notes:
[h1]The Brassbarian returns, with Michaela, Clyde and fully fleshed out waves 11-20![/h1]

[h2]New Instruments and Items[/h2]
[i]Instruments:[/i]
[list]
[*] Vinyl Record
[*] Bassoon
[*] Maracas
[*] Cymbal
[*] Chime
[*] Crystal Flute
[*] Triangle
[/list]

[i]Active Items:[/i]
[list]
[*] Sausage Roll
[/list]

[i]Passive Items:[/i]
[list]
[*] DvD Player
[*] Pierce Gloves
[/list]

[h2]Technical Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Gurdy’s hitbox has shrunk in size significantly, both vertically and horizontally. Now you won’t be
hit by projectiles fired from higher elevations, and projectiles should be slightly easier to dodge
in general
[*] You can now steer the dodge roll
[*] You now have more air control in general
[*] You now have more movement control during the jump
[*] Jump lands slightly sooner to feel less floaty
[*] Jump cooldown upon landing increased from 0.2 to 0.4 seconds
[*] Dash can now be triggered by pressing shift
[*] You can now input dodges and jumps during the dash
[*] Added a setting which allows you to make the dodge only trigger during dashes
[*] Added more detail to various glossary entries
[*] Your minions killing enemies now also counts as you killing enemies
[*] Cinderloop now causes explosions when hitting instead of when breaking, this has no relevance
in the previous version but interacts favourably with new items
[*] Default orbit distance has been increased from 100 to 160, this affects violin and the stereo
shirt
[*] Destructible Obstacles (like the stone loop and gatling pillars) can now be damaged with area
effects like the double bass
[*] Projectiles lose less speed when ricocheting
[*] The glossary has a section dedicated to enemies
[*] The augment shop now has a soundtrack
[*] Gurdy now has a whistle attack when not using an instrument
[*] Enjoy the new difficulty settings Baldrron
[/list]

[h2]VFX[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reworked and added several new map layouts
[*] New main menu with view of arena
[*] Reworked Gatling Gary's character model
[*] Fleshed out arena design
[*] Shopkeepers have new concept art placeholders
[*] New transition particles for portals
[*] Tons of new item and instrument effects
[/list]

[h2]Audio [/h2]
[list]
[*] Jerome now has a theme!
[*] Brassbarian theme has been reworked from version 0.06a
[*] Reworked several sfx
[/list]

[h2]Enemy Changes[/h2]

[i]Roger[/i]
Desired range increased from 475 to 525

[i]Tybalt[/i]
Fixed a bug where the charge couldn’t be reliably jumped over

[i]Gatling Gary[/i]
Now immune to most disabling effects, such as stuns and fear (This does not apply to how
Gary stuns himself when knocking himself into walls)

This will be applied to other bosses and certain elites in the future as well

Health reduced from 100 to 75 again

Moved back from wave 20 to 10 again

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[b][u]Instrument Changes:[/u][/b]
[i]Xylophone[/i]
Primary cooldown increased from 0.5 to 0.8 seconds
Minion lifespan increased from 10 to 15 seconds

[i]Lotus Flute[/i]
Primary projectile speed reduced from 2000 to 1300
Primary now destroys older projectiles

[i]Trumpet[/i]
TLDR: Primary charged attacks are now much faster, and the secondary is more consistent and
has a higher range but deals less damage

Primary charge time reduced from 0.5 to 0.4s

Primary now has its cooldown on charged shots reduced from 0.5 to 0.25s

Primary uncharged cooldown increased from 0.5 to 0.65s (now matches total charged
cooldown)

Primary water gain changed from 25/40% to 20/30%

Secondary phase 2 moved from 50% to 45% charge

Secondary now has an additional phase at 90% charge

Secondary damage rescaled from 1/1.5 to 0.5/1/1.5

Secondary range increased from 200->500 to 250->750

Water loss per second decreased from 10% to 5%

[i]Saxophone[/i]
Charged shots reduce the remaining cooldown from 0.5 to 0.3 seconds

[i]Violin[/i]
Orbit speed increased from 90 to 120 degrees per second

[i]Double Bass[/i]
Primary swing now pulls you forward at a speed of 325 down from 500

Primary now has more movement control during the swing

[b][u]Item Changes[/u][/b]
[i]Cinderloop[/i]
Burn now deals damage over 2 seconds instead of 4. The total damage is unchanged, it simply
happens faster. This applies to both the active and the augment

[i]Frigid Loop[/i]
Damage increased from 1 to 1.5

[i]Stone Loop[/i]
Now also destroys projectiles after being kicked

[i]Soul Loop[/i]
Now also gains charges when your minions die

No longer applies a movement slow

Now applies a three second long fear during which enemies run away from you and can’t attack

[i]Electro Loop[/i]
Now causes enemies to be charged by static, taking an additional 0.5 damage from all sources
for 10 seconds after being hit

Augment has been reworked and now causes the last enemy you hit with the augmented item
to be charged by static, taking an additional 0.5 damage from all sources for 10 seconds after
being hit

Damage reduced from 2 to 1

[i]Gusty Loop[/i]
Now pushes projectiles over 0.5 seconds instead of instantly, and pushes projectiles with 50%
more force

Horizontal knockback increased from 750 to 900

Vertical knockback increased from 100 to 125

Cooldown decreased from 6 to 4.5 seconds

[i]Repulsor[/i]
Pushback speed increased from 300 to 350

Pushback percent speed increased from 100 to 125

[i]Thornmantle[/i]
Range increased from 550 to 800

Projectile speed increased from 1500 to 2000

Now fires half notes instead of three-eighth notes

No longer fires a shockwave of 9 notes in the direction of the hit. Instead it now fires 5 notes
towards random nearby enemies

[i]Stereo Shirt[/i]
Orbit speed increased from 120 to 180 degrees per second

[i]Ballet Skirt[/i]
Triggers from jumping as well

Fires 16 projectiles up from 8

Ballet skirt now has a delay of 0.03 seconds between projectiles down from 0.05

[i]Firewalkers[/i]
Moved from T2 to T1

Cost reduced from 10 to 5

Burn trail duration increased from 2 to 3 seconds

Burn trail radius increased from 75 to 100 units

Now deals damage every 0.5 seconds, up from 0.25 seconds

[i]Recharging Robe[/i]
Cost decreased from 30 to 25

Recharge time decreased from 15 to 12 seconds

Now affected by cooldown reduction

[i]Metronome[/i]
Now has an indicator in your status bar letting you know when the cooldown reset will occur
Fixed a bug where metronome’s cooldown reduction triggered 1 beat later than intended

[i]Sprinter Shoes[/i]
Moved from T1 to T2

Cost increased from 4 to 10

Stacks are now also reset by jumping

Stacks now grant 6% movement speed up from 5%

Stacks now grant 6% attack speed up from 2.5%

Stacks now have a maximum of 5 stacks, down from 6

[h2]Challenges[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Challenges!
[*] Challenge Layouts!
[*] Instead of using the standard map pool, the next set of waves will take place in a more
challenging map variant
[*] Changed Challenges
[/list]

[i]Change to Lobber:[/i]
Number of projectiles per attack reduced from 2-5 to 1

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed enemies to spam their jump action in specific circumstances
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the player to miss the extra life provided by life armour when
respawning
[*] Fixed a bug where the instrument UI wasn’t correctly updated when discarding your only
instrument
[*] Fixed a bug where discarding an instrument while selecting an instrument at a later index would
change which instrument you had selected, in some cases leading you to selecting nothing
[*] Fixed a bug where boss intros were being created multiple times after respawning, causing the
skip animation bug to work incorrectly
[/list]

notes.title: Another Hotfix
notes.notes:
[b]Hotfix v0.1a2[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a return to menu button
[*]Fixed a bug where when multiple formations were present defeating all but one enemy in a
formation would cause that enemy to stop functioning
[*]Fixed leap lords not functioning
[*]Fixed firewalkers not functioning
[*]Fixed a bug where dodging into an obstacle could launch the player due to the dodge and roll
momentum stacking together
[*]Fixed a bug where the dodge roll went further than intended due to carrying some of the
dodge’s momentum
[*]Fixed a bug where bottled storm continued to push enemies that were outside of its area
[*]Fixed a bug where selecting a shop item while the previous one was playing its selection
animation would make it appear as though both were being selected
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix for Gamescom Day 2
notes.notes: Fixed various bugs relating to movement and instruments

notes.title: Patch 0.1a is out! Let the Speedrunning competition begin!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Patch v0.1a and the Speedrunning Competition[/b][/h1]

[h2]We're hosting another speedrun competition and the winners get prizes![/h2]
Check out how to join on our discord server: https://discord.gg/v9bJJcb4cH


[h2]New Feature: Glossary[/h2]
A glossary has been added to the game containing the tooltips of every item and instrument
you’ve encountered. This will be updated with more comprehensive descriptions and
information over time.
Many preview tooltips have also been changed to be more closely related to the item’s effects

[h2]Speedrun Features[/h2]
A speedrun timer has been added back into the game.

[h2]Controller Support[/h2]
Controller support is mostly implemented, the bounty board, augment system, settings and the respawn menu are still missing controller support but everything else should be ready to go.

[h2]Balance Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]All note projectiles are now significantly larger

[*]Various layouts have had their size significantly reduced

[*]Many starting items have had their costs reduced from 5 to 3-4

[*]Formations now attack much more consistently

[*]Units no longer randomly fire sequences of attacks on their own

[*]Saxophonists and Heavy Brass now always fire their attacks in sequence

[*]Fixed bugs where various Gatling Gary attacks didn’t originate from his instrument

[*]Gatling’s arena is significantly smaller

[*]Gatling’s self knockback on various attacks has been increased

[*]Gatling has been temporarily moved to wave 20 (this will be reverted when the second boss is
brought back)

[*]Gatling life temporarily raised from 75 to 100 (due to the player having access to more powerful
items by wave 20)

[*]Gatling has a sick intro animation

[*]Wave 10 has been temporarily replaced with a formation of regular enemies. These enemies
spawn with extra glass hearts.

[*]New bounty “Heart of Glass” added. Causes all enemies in the next 3 waves to spawn with 2
extra glass hearts.

[*]Melee units now charge almost immediately after their shield is hit

[*]Saxophonist and Heavy Brass projectiles land faster

[*]Heavy Brass shockwave projectiles increased from 16 to 32

[*]Saxophone shockwave range and speed increased

[*]Heavy Brass shockwave range and speed increased

[*]Enemy hitboxes increased

[*]Lyre spacing between shots increased

[*]Saxophone shockwaves now match the original note type

[*]Saxophone shockwaves now have a higher range and speed, and no longer vary based on note
type

[*]Uncharged Saxophone Primary now fires a two-eighth note that creates a shockwave of
two-eighth notes, previously it was a quarter note spawning eighth notes

[*]Charged Saxophone Primary now fires a three-eighth note that creates a shockwave of
three-eighth notes, previously it was a half note spawning two-eighth notes

[*]Saxophone shots now pierce enemies and only create shockwaves upon hitting the ground, as
a result they no longer create shockwaves in the air when hitting enemies

[*]Double Bass secondary attack reworked again. Now charges forward with a short spinning
swing, shattering projectiles and knocking enemies in the direction of the charge.

[*]Eggs and the shockwave they leave behind are faster

[*]Yolk Day Basket no longer allows you to have multiple eggs

[*]Yolk Day Basket’s cooldown now starts when the egg is thrown

[*]Yolk Day Basket’s cooldown is now 6 seconds, reduced from 8 seconds

[*]Yolk Day Basket’s cooldown is now affected by cooldown reduction

[*]Metronome now also affects the cooldown of non-active items
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed several bugs where area of effects were failing to trigger certain augments
[*]Fixed a bug related to various “proximity” based area effects having incorrect knockback
directions
[*]Fixed a bug where when spawning too many enemies (via very late waves and/or bounties)
enemies would run out of space and start spawning out of the map
[*]Fixed a bug where the cursor would be missing when the player died
[*]Small Technical Changes
[*]Various tutorial prompts have been added
[/list]
